summary: Validate reserved MP4 fragment decode-time flags
before: Both MP4 wrappers admitted all four V0/V1 tfdt witnesses with low/high reserved flags. Original core result: zero-flag packet/clock/budget controls pass; reserved-flag refusal fails (1 passed, 1 failed).
after: Reject nonzero reserved tfdt FullBox flags before consuming decode time. Eleven core and twenty player checks pass with no failures/ignored tests. Zero-flag V0/V1 fragments preserve three exact packet clocks and RGB frames at 50Hz/60ms, eight seeks per file, rewind, repeated EOF and budget rejection. Damaged companions fail specifically on their flags before decoding.
tests_run: cargo test --locked --offline --no-default-features --test mp4_tfdt_flags --test mp4_tfhd_defaults --test mp4_hybrid_fragments --test mp4_time_header_sizes --test mp4_unknown_duration
cargo test --locked --offline --features player --test mp4_tfdt_flags --test mp4_tfhd_defaults --test mp4_hybrid_fragments --test mp4_time_header_sizes --test mp4_unknown_duration
independence: One omitted tfdt flag admission check in fragment indexing, independent of movie/media header size validation. Versions and bit variants count once.
